name: Kammelna
note: Saudi gaming company behind the Baloot app (kammelna.com); Al-Ettifaq front sponsor since 2022 per club announcement. Owner not established from a public source: kammelna.com is behind a script check for us and names no owner; press (gamesindustry.biz 2016, PocketGamer.biz 2025-08-25) names founder Essam Alzamel, CEO Bader Al Zamil and a SAR 200m+ Impact46 investment without a stake breakdown. Left unrated until an ownership source is found.
